  ];
  // bridge to spec textContent if present
  const items = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  if (items.length >= 9) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      cardsData[i].glyph = items[i * 3].text;
      cardsData[i].title = items[i * 3 + 1].text;
      cardsData[i].body = items[i * 3 + 2].text;
    }
  }

  const cards = [];
  const shadowMats = [];
  const glyphEmissiveUniforms = [];

  function buildIconDisc(glyph, focal) {
    const disc = new Group();
    const geo = new CylinderGeometry(0.2, 0.2, 0.05, 48);
    const mat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial();
    const surf = new Color(C.surface).lerp(new Color(C.paper), 0.12);
    mat.colorNode = vec3(surf.r, surf.g, surf.b);
    mat.roughnessNode = float(0.55);
    mat.metalnessNode = float(0.5);
    const body = new Mesh(geo, mat);
    body.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    disc.add(body);
    disposables.push(geo, mat);

    // glyph carried on disc, accent red, emissive-driven via material on MSDF text
    const glyphObj = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(String(glyph), {
      fontSize: 20, color: C.accent, align: 'center',
    });
    glyphObj.position.set(0, -0.005, 0.032);
    glyphObj.scale.setScalar(0.011);
    disc.add(glyphObj);

    // emissive halo plane behind disc — single brightest read, focal on center card
    const haloGeo = new CircleGeometry(0.24, 48);
    const haloMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, depthWrite: false });
    const acc = new Color(C.accent);
    const em = uniform(focal ? 1.6 : 1.1);
    const dd = uv().sub(vec2(0.5, 0.5)).length().mul(2.0);
    haloMat.colorNode = vec3(acc.r, acc.g, acc.b).mul(em.mul(0.28));
    haloMat.opacityNode = smoothstep(1.0, 0.1, dd).mul(0.55);
    const halo = new Mesh(haloGeo, haloMat);
    halo.position.z = -0.02;
    disc.add(halo);
    disposables.push(haloGeo, haloMat);
    glyphEmissiveUniforms.push(em);

    return { disc, em };
  }

  function buildCard(data, i) {
    const holder = new Group(); // static slot position
    const card = new Group();   // animated lift target
    holder.add(card);

    const x = (i - 1) * (CARD_W + GAP);
    const focal = i === 1;
    holder.position.set(x, focal ? 0.06 : 0, focal ? 0.08 : 0);

    // slab
    const faceGeo = new PlaneGeometry(CARD_W, CARD_H);
    const face = new Mesh(faceGeo, makeCardMaterial());
    card.add(face);
    disposables.push(faceGeo);

    // slight extrusion back panel for physical depth
    const backGeo = new PlaneGeometry(CARD_W, CARD_H);
    const backMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial();
    const inkC = new Color(C.ink);
    backMat.colorNode = vec3(inkC.r, inkC.g, inkC.b);
    backMat.roughnessNode = float(0.7);
    backMat.metalnessNode = float(0.2);
    const back = new Mesh(backGeo, backMat);
    back.position.z = -0.04;
    card.add(back);
    disposables.push(backGeo, backMat);

    // interior layout: padding 0.375, icon seat -> 0.25 gap -> title -> 0.125 gap -> body
    const topY = CARD_H / 2 - 0.375;
    const { disc, em } = buildIconDisc(data.glyph, focal);
    disc.position.set(0, topY - 0.2, 0.05);
    card.add(disc);

    const title = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(String(data.title), {
      fontSize: 20, color: C.paper, align: 'center', maxWidthPx: 220,
    });
    title.position.set(0, topY - 0.4 - 0.25 - 0.1, 0.02);
    title.scale.setScalar(0.011);
    card.add(title);

    const bodyText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(String(data.body), {
      fontSize: 13, color: C.paper, align: 'center', maxWidthPx: 200,
    });
    bodyText.position.set(0, topY - 0.4 - 0.25 - 0.2 - 0.125 - 0.18, 0.02);
    bodyText.scale.setScalar(0.011);
    card.add(bodyText);

    // contact shadow (grounding)
    const shGeo = new CircleGeometry(1.0, 48);
    const shMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, depthWrite: false });
    const shD = uv().sub(vec2(0.5, 0.5)).length().mul(2.0);
    const shOp = uniform(0.5);
    shMat.colorNode = vec3(0, 0, 0);
    shMat.opacityNode = smoothstep(1.0, 0.0, shD).mul(shOp);
    const shadow = new Mesh(shGeo, shMat);
    shadow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    shadow.position.set(0, -CARD_H / 2 - 0.08, 0.1);
    shadow.scale.set(CARD_W * 0.85, CARD_H * 0.28, 1);
    holder.add(shadow);
    disposables.push(shGeo, shMat);
    shadowMats.push(shOp);

    cards.push({ holder, card, shadow, shOp, em, focal });
    return holder;
  }

  cardsData.forEach((d, i) => root.add(buildCard(d, i)));

  // ---------- mount: stagger-cards fade-up ----------
  const mountTl = gsap.timeline();
  cards.forEach((c, i) => {
    const targets = [];
    c.card.traverse((o) => { if (o.material) targets.push(o.material); });
    targets.forEach((m) => { if ('opacity' in m) { /* keep MSDF/opacity as-is */ } });
    mountTl.fromTo(
      c.card.position,
      { y: -0.2 },
      { y: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out' },
      i * 0.08
    );
    mountTl.fromTo(
      c.card.scale,
      { x: 0.98, y: 0.98, z: 0.98 },
      { x: 1, y: 1, z: 1, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power4.out' },
      i * 0.08
    );
  });
  timelines.push(mountTl);

  // ---------- primitives from config (none expected, but honor contract) ----------
  const prims = config.cinematicPrimitives ?? [];
  for (const p of prims) {
    const fn = ctx.primitives?.[p.name];
    if (fn) primHandles.push(fn(root, p.params));
  }

  // ---------- interactions: hover lift / press ----------
  const hoverTls = new Map();
  function liftCard(idx, on) {
    const c = cards[idx];
    if (!c) return;
    const prev = hoverTls.get(idx);
    if (prev) prev.kill();
    const tl = gsap.timeline();
    if (on) {
      tl.to(c.card.position, { y: 0.06, z: 0.12, duration: 0.18, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
      tl.to(c.shadow.scale, { x: CARD_W * 1.05, y: CARD_H * 0.34, duration: 0.18, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
      tl.to(c.shOp, { value: 0.32, duration: 0.18, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
      tl.to(c.em, { value: 2.2, duration: 0.18, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
    } else {
      tl.to(c.card.position, { y: 0, z: 0, duration: 0.18, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
      tl.to(c.shadow.scale, { x: CARD_W * 0.85, y: CARD_H * 0.28, duration: 0.18, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
      tl.to(c.shOp, { value: 0.5, duration: 0.18, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
      tl.to(c.em, { value: c.focal ? 1.6 : 1.1, duration: 0.18, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
    }
    hoverTls.set(idx, tl);
    timelines.push(tl);
  }

  function cardIndexFromHit(hit) {
    let o = hit?.object ?? hit;
    while (o) {
      const idx = cards.findIndex((c) => c.holder === o || c.card === o);
      if (idx >= 0) return idx;
      o = o.parent;
    }
    return -1;
  }

  root.userData.handlers = {
    pointerover: (e) => { const i = cardIndexFromHit(e); if (i >= 0) liftCard(i, true); },
    pointerout: (e) => { const i = cardIndexFromHit(e); if (i >= 0) liftCard(i, false); },
    pointerdown: (e) => {
      const i = cardIndexFromHit(e);
      if (i >= 0) {
        const tl = gsap.timeline();
        tl.to(cards[i].card.scale, { x: 0.97, y: 0.97, z: 0.97, duration: 0.12, ease: 'back.out(2)' })
          .to(cards[i].card.scale, { x: 1, y: 1, z: 1, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out' });
        timelines.push(tl);
      }
    },
  };

  root.userData.cleanup = () => {
    timelines.forEach((t) => t.kill());
    hoverTls.forEach((t) => t.kill());
    primHandles.forEach((h) => h?.cleanup?.());
    disposables.forEach((d) => d?.dispose?.());
    root.traverse((o) => {
      if (o.geometry?.dispose) o.geometry.dispose();
      const m = o.material;
      if (m) (Array.isArray(m) ? m : [m]).forEach((mm) => mm?.dispose?.());
    });
  };

  return root;
}
